name: Opennote
summary: A light notebook style with ivory paper canvas, old-style serif headings, quiet sans-serif UI text, sepia CTAs, ink-violet feature panels, 10px corners, hairline borders, and sparse hand-drawn marginalia.

ivoryPage.role: Primary canvas, page background, and card surface

inkCharcoal.role: Primary text, body copy, and icon strokes

pressedBlack.role: Illustration fill, SVG marks, and fine ink details

graphiteRule.role: Hairline borders, dividers, card outlines, and image frames

smoke.role: Muted helper text, captions, secondary metadata, inactive tabs

slateBody.role: Secondary body copy and subdued icon detail

softHalo.role: Alternate surface, recessed panels, and secondary card backgrounds

sepia.role: Primary action fill and key accent text

inkViolet.role: Feature-panel surface, deep accent headings, and full-bleed reset section

forestInk.role: Secondary accent text, category tags, and decorative strokes

oxblood.role: Tertiary accent, pull quote emphasis, and rare highlight text

marginYellow.role: Decorative highlighter wash and illustration fill only

typography.displaySubstitute: Source Serif Pro, Tiempos Text, or PT Serif

elevation.separation: 1px Graphite Rule borders, whitespace, and rare full-bleed Ink Violet panel contrast

components.sepiaFilledCta: Primary button with Sepia background, Ivory Page text, 10px radius, compact padding, and no shadow.
components.outlinedGhostButton: Transparent secondary action with 1px Ash Border and Ink Charcoal text.
components.tabNavigation: Text-only tab row with Smoke inactive labels and Ink Charcoal active label plus underline.
components.inkVioletFeaturePanel: Full-width dark feature surface with ivory serif heading, sans-serif body, and one ghost action.
components.universityLogoStrip: Monochrome wordmark row floating directly on the ivory canvas.
components.centeredHeroBlock: Small line illustration, two-line serif headline, and one Sepia CTA.
components.marginaliaIllustration: Sparse black line drawings placed in negative space with optional Margin Yellow wash.
components.featureCard: Bordered ivory card with 10px radius, 24px padding, serif title, sans-serif copy, and no shadow.
components.headerBar: Transparent navigation with a 1px Graphite Rule bottom border.
components.creamBandBackground: Ruled-paper-like section with subtle hairlines and warm/cool paper tint.

dos: Use Sepia as the only filled button background.
Set headlines in IowanOld or a similar serif at weight 400.
Reserve Ink Violet for one full-bleed feature panel per page.
Draw structural separation with 1px Graphite Rule borders.
Place hand-drawn black line illustrations loosely in negative space.
Pair serif headlines with small sans-serif subheads.
donts: Do not introduce a modern blue, bright green, or red accent.
Do not apply drop shadows, glow effects, or layered elevation.
Do not bold the serif headlines.
Do not use pure white as the main canvas.
Do not use sans-serif for headlines or feature titles above 24px.
Do not apply Margin Yellow to buttons, badges, or interactive surfaces.
Do not stack more than one filled Sepia CTA in a single viewport.
